R is a GIS ... or at least it can be! In this video lesson, which is a lecture rather than a code-along-video, I cover:

* What a GIS is
* Coordinate Reference Systems (CRSs) ... this is super important
* Types of shapefiles -- points, lines, and polygons
* What a raster file is
* Core GIS concepts such as spatial grain and spatial extent (we will explore these concepts in depth in the future!)
